name: Ziba Peterson
role: Early elder on the 1830 mission to the Lamanites
dateNote: He was an elder by June 1830 and was named for the western mission in October 1830.
importance: Section 32 adds him to the mission of Oliver Cowdery, Peter Whitmer Jr., and Parley P. Pratt to the Lamanites. In August 1831 section 58 takes away what had been given him, because he had not confessed his sins. He was reordained in 1832 but was excommunicated by June 1833. He later moved to California and served as a sheriff.
connections: He traveled with Oliver Cowdery, Parley P. Pratt, and Peter Whitmer Jr. He married Rebecca Hopper in Missouri in August 1831.
reviewNote: JSP gives birth about 1810 and death 1849 at Hangtown (Placerville), California, but also cites an 1880 Oregon census that conflicts. Death year is therefore uncertain.
